0022600170.text: The Suns (1-3, 12th in the West) make their fifth trip of the season to Golden State, having lost their last two games and gone 0-2 on the road, while the Warriors (4-3, 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back) enter on a four-game winning streak. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with a shoulder injury that required surgery, while Golden State is without Draymond Green (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry (rest), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with a knee issue. The Suns lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 131-122 win in Phoenix on October 24, though they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
